name: enc_h
comment: Outer height incl. lid (5 mm steps)

name: sw_x
comment: Mains rocker switch centre X (right of display)

name: sw_z
comment: Mains rocker switch centre Z (aligned with display centre)

name: ban_pitch
comment: Banana spacing; leaves room for the NEG / EARTH / POS labels

name: split_z
comment: Horizontal split between bananas and display

name: slot_bridge
comment: Bridge between vent slot segments (slots max 20 long)

name: vent_len_max
comment: Longest vent slot; longer runs are split by slot_bridge

name: lid_vent_margin
comment: Lid vent fields: X margin from the outer wall

name: lid_vent_gap
comment: Gap between the fan and the lid vent fields (Y)

name: lid_vent_n
comment: Lid vent slots per field (follows enc_w)

name: grille_l
comment: Fan grille: longest slot run (Y), split by slot_bridge

name: fv_front_margin
comment: Front floor vents: X margin from the outer wall

name: fv_front_gap
comment: Front floor vents: gap from the inner front wall

name: fv_side_in
comment: Side floor vents: outermost slot centre from the outer wall

name: fv_right_n
expression: max(1, floor((enc_w/2 - fv_side_in - (psu_x + psu_hole_dx/2 + psu_boss_d/2 + fv_side_clear)) / vent_pitch) + 1)
comment: Right floor vents: slots that fit between the outer wall and the PSU standoff (follows enc_w)

name: fv_side_rear_margin
comment: Side floor vents: end this far from the outer rear wall

name: fv_right_front_margin
comment: Right floor vents: start this far from the outer front wall

name: fv_left_front_margin
comment: Left floor vents: start this far from the outer front wall (clears the AC terminal)

name: foot_inset
comment: Foot holes: inset from each outer corner

name: psu_x
comment: PSU PCB centre X (move the AC-DC2416 component to match)

name: psu_y
comment: PSU PCB centre Y (move the AC-DC2416 component to match)

name: psu_boss_hole
comment: PSU standoff hole for M3 heat-set insert (5 OD x 4 long)

name: lm_x
comment: LM2596 lower standoff X (rear wall inside)

name: lm_boss_w
comment: LM2596 post width (square section, 2.5 mm wall round the insert)

name: lm_boss_h
comment: LM2596 post length from the wall; the 45° gusset is as long again along the wall

name: lm_boss_hole
comment: LM2596 post hole for M3 heat-set insert (5 OD x 4 long), 5 deep

name: clip_root_h
comment: Snap clip root height (bonded to the wall)

name: clip_hook
comment: Hook depth into the top's wall

name: clip_pocket_w
comment: Hook pocket width in the top's wall

name: clip_y_front
comment: Side clips: front pair Y centre

name: clip_y_rear
comment: Side clips: rear pair Y centre

name: clip_x_front
comment: Front wall clip X centre (behind the rocker)

name: clip_x_rear
comment: Rear wall clip X centre (under the IEC inlet)

name: fv_side_clear
comment: Side floor vents: clearance to the PSU standoffs

name: fv_left_n
expression: max(1, floor((enc_w/2 - fv_side_in + (psu_x - psu_hole_dx/2 - psu_boss_d/2 - fv_side_clear)) / vent_pitch) + 1)
comment: Left floor vents: slots that fit between the outer wall and the PSU standoff (follows enc_w)

name: name_h
comment: Name capital height (set so the text covers > 60 % of enc_w)

name: name_front
comment: Name baseline from the front outer wall

name: name_depth
comment: Name recess depth (one first layer when printed lid-down)

name: label_z
comment: Socket labels baseline Z (above the seam, below the display bezel)

name: mains_z
comment: MAINS baseline Z (above the rocker bezel)

name: ban_x
comment: Banana row centre X (0 = centred on the box)

name: label_h
comment: Front panel label capital height (80 % of the lid name)

name: insert_ch
comment: Lead-in chamfer on the heat-set insert holes (PSU standoffs, LM2596 posts)

name: fan_csk_d
comment: Fan screw countersink diameter on the lid top, 90 deg (M3 countersunk ISO 10642, head 6.72)

name: fan_grille_r
comment: Fan grille: slots end inside this circle (the fan blade area), so the outer slots are shorter
